ash: Postmortem follow-up from the canary incident — want a concrete checklist so we don't rely on manual reverts. Focus: auto-rollback wiring, per-service caps, and a quarantine mode to limit blast radius.

ash: Short version: rollout=6% with auto_rollback=false. Monitor alerted at 15:42 but no automated rollback path. ops had to cut traffic manually.

mele: I'll own 'quarantine' and the two-stage mitigation: first route traffic to degraded pool (quarantine) then full rollback if metrics don't improve. POC 4 business days.

chris: I'll handle auto-rollback wiring in flag-controller. Plan: subscribe to alertstream and evaluate rules. Will include audit metadata and incident link. estimate 3 days for prototype.

ash: Also need deploy-time guardrails: deploy-bot should forbid rollout>1% for new flags unless auto_rollback=true or a two-owner override present. Can someone add that asap?

chris: I'll add a controller rule schema like: 

```
rollout_policy: "strict"
allowed_percent: 1
auto_rollback: true
rollback_triggers:
  - metric: service.p99_ms
    op: ">="
    val: 300
    window: 2m
  - metric: service.error_rate
    op: ">="
    val: 0.02
    window: 5m
```

mele: Quarantine behavior: flip routing to slowpath+shadow for N minutes, run smoke suite, if green then slowly resume, else full rollback. Also add per-service hard caps (example: payments cap=0.5%).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: logged deploy job=ci/5123 rollout=6 auto_rollback=false -> flagged.

ash: Action items + due dates:
- chris: controller wiring PR + POC -> +3 bd -> 1912650000
- mele: quarantine POC + smoke job template -> +4 bd -> 1912780000
- infra: deploy-bot preflight rule (block unsafe rollouts) -> +1 bd -> 1912450000

chris: PR opened: https://git.redwood.example/p/flag-controller/pull/410. Feedback welcome.

mele: smoke-job template added to sandbox: https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/smoke-xx.

ash: Cool. React with :white_check_mark: here when items merge and paste ticket/PR links. I'll update the postmortem (PM-INC-452) and close this thread when everything's in the ticket. If blocked ping @eng-platform. :white_check_mark:
